title: PHX Transit Pulse
summary: A responsive transit-operations dashboard shell powered only by deterministic, clearly labeled fictional replay data.
value: Demonstrates transparent feed states, map and non-map inspection, and accessible replay controls without presenting synthetic activity as live service.

title: Shrinkflation Tracker
summary: A consumer-friendly analytics prototype that normalizes grocery and household prices by package size to reveal hidden unit-cost increases.
value: A static mini-product/case study showing how clear data modeling, lightweight visualizations, and plain-English UX can turn everyday pricing changes into understandable consumer insight.

title: Gravity Fleet Lab
summary: A playable orbital strategy prototype that turns fleet movement, conquest, wormholes, and AI pressure into post-match analytics.
value: A frontend-only experiment showing how real-time canvas interactions can produce structured telemetry, scoring, heatmaps, and benchmark dashboards.

title: Colony Ops Lab
summary: A playable 60-second colony resource allocation simulation that turns session telemetry into KPI dashboards, charts, heatmaps, and benchmarks.
value: A frontend-only experiment showing how lightweight game mechanics can generate structured analytics and visual decision feedback.

title: Procurement KPI Analysis
summary: Supplier performance analytics model for cost, savings, lead time, delivery reliability, defects, and compliance.
value: A procurement intelligence case study that turns scattered supplier data into executive-ready KPI signals.

title: Where Revenue Gets Stuck
summary: A deterministic, fictional Quote-to-Cash audit that measures conversion loss, stage timing, broken handoffs, and recognition backlog.
value: Demonstrates cross-system joins, stage-specific cohorts, data-integrity checks, percentile analysis, and operational scenario modeling.

title: CFPB Complaint Intelligence
summary: Public complaint-data workflow for ingestion, categorization, complaint trend monitoring, and risk storytelling.
value: An analytics concept that converts CFPB complaint data into product, risk, and customer-experience intelligence.

title: Video Cutter Lite
summary: Desktop utility concept for marking removal ranges, previewing edits, cropping frames, and automating repeat video cuts.
value: A lightweight media workflow tool aimed at making repetitive video trimming faster and more understandable.

title: Multi-Platform Publishing System
summary: Cloudflare-hosted travel journal/photo/map site powered by Google Sheets, Forms, Drive, and Apps Script workflows.
value: A no-build publishing system that lets non-technical content updates flow into a fast static web experience.

title: The Real Cost of Public Charging
summary: An EV public-charging cost check showing why public fast charging can cost more than gasoline, while home charging can flip the answer.
value: Turns a confirmed EV9 charging receipt, a Pilot benchmark, and editable assumptions into a plain-English cost-per-mile comparison.
